phrases.text: When the sun is put out
and when the stars fall down
and when the mountains are blown away
and when pregnant camels are left untended
and when wild beasts are gathered together
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His saying, the Exalted: وَإِذَا الْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ ("And when the wild beasts are gathered together") (81:5).

phrases.text: and when the seas are set on fire
and when the souls ˹and their bodies˺ are paired ˹once more˺
and when baby girls, buried alive, are asked
for what crime they were put to death
and when the records ˹of deeds˺ are laid open
and when the sky is stripped away
phrases.head: Statement concerning the interpretation of the word of the Exalted: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ كُشِطَتْ ("And when the heaven is stripped away") (81:11).

phrases.text: and when the Hellfire is fiercely flared up
and when Paradise is brought near
˹on that Day˺ each soul will know what ˹deeds˺ it has brought along
I do swear by the receding stars
which travel and hide
and the night as it falls
phrases.head: Explanation of the saying of the Exalted: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ ("By the night when it passes") (81:17).

phrases.text: and the day as it breaks
Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the Word of ˹Allah delivered by Gabriel,˺ a noble messenger-angel
full of power, held in honour by the Lord of the Throne
phrases.ar: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِنْدَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ

phrases.text: obeyed there ˹in heaven˺,
phrases.head: The explanation of His statement, the Exalted: مُطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ ("who is obeyed, there, trustworthy") (81:21).

phrases.text: and trustworthy
And your fellow man is not insane
And he did see that ˹angel˺ on the clear horizon
and he does not withhold ˹what is revealed to him of˺ the unseen
And this ˹Quran˺ is not the word of an outcast devil
So what ˹other˺ path would you take
Surely this ˹Quran˺ is only a reminder to the whole world
phrases.head: The explanation of His statement, the Exalted: إِنْ هُوَ إِلا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ ("It is nothing but a reminder for the worlds") (81:27).

phrases.text: to whoever of you wills to take the Straight Way
But you cannot will ˹to do so˺, except by the Will of Allah, the Lord of all worlds
phrases.ar: وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
